_comments: NIGHTLY FINANCE EXCEPTION CHECK, TYPE 3 (golive #279). Runs the Action in
`.sales-finance-exception-actions.json`. Own file, as with the forecast job.
02:30 UTC, after the forecast snapshot and after the close of business in every zone the
business day is judged in. The exception date is the business day, from the business time zone,
not the UTC day the job fires on.
· ConcurrencyMode `Skip` — two concurrent runs would race on the same deals; accounting's
dedupe key makes that harmless, but there is no reason to invite it.
· MissedRunPolicy `RunOnce` — each run re-reads every qualifying deal, so one catch-up run
covers any number of missed nights.
· RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun `false` — the first run waits for the schedule.
SEEDED Disabled, like the orders finance-exception jobs. Enable it once every deal owner's employee
record is linked to a login (the query "Sales: Deal Owners Without a Linked Login" lists the ones
that are not); until then each such deal raises a row that cannot be cleared. Linking a login
later does unlock it: the next run re-raises the deal and accounting refreshes an Open row's creator.

fields.Name: Sales — Won Deals With Unconfirmed Orders (nightly)
fields.Description: Raises a WON_DEAL_ORDER_NOT_CONFIRMED finance exception for each won deal whose order is missing or not Confirmed. Skips when the exception type is missing or inactive.
